name: Number plate
purpose: Shows a vehicle's registration number as it looks on the vehicle: on a yellow number plate, in the DVLA's own typeface. Small on a vehicle's card, large on its detail screen. A white front plate, blank, stands for any vehicle, such as on a search for one.

origin.notes: The app's own: Text in its DVLA-VRM typeface on GOVUKColors.Fills.registrationPlate, with a black rounded border, in VehicleSummaryView (Body size) and in VehicleDetailView and VehicleCheckResultView (extra large). The typeface is the app's file, unchanged, under the SIL Open Font License, whose text is beside it. Screen readers hear Number plate:, then the registration spelled out, as the app's speechSpellsOutCharacters.

size.description: small, as on a vehicle's card, growing with the text size; large, as on a vehicle's detail screen.

variant.description: rear: yellow, as the app shows a vehicle's registration. front: white, with a thicker stroke, as the app draws the blank ABC plate on its vehicle search.

inputs.content: The registration number, as it's written on the plate, such as AB71 CDE.

rules: Use it only for a vehicle's registration number.
Write the registration as it's shown on the plate, in capitals, with its space, such as AB71 CDE.
Use small beside a vehicle's name, such as on its card, and large on its own on the vehicle's detail screen.
Use the rear plate for a vehicle's registration. Use the front plate for a blank one, ABC, that stands for any vehicle, such as on a search for one.
